title: Large Language Models and Deep Learning Fundamentals
description: Fundamentals of large language models and deep learning, including transformer implementation in Pytorch, training and inference, performance analysis, hyperparameter tuning, and architectural variations (ablations).
impact: A ground-up transformer lab that connects model code, training traces, optimizer behavior, and deployment tradeoffs.
proof: Implemented transformer training and inference components from scratch
Profiled GPU behavior with Nsys traces and exported interactive analysis
Compared ablations, learning-rate sweeps, and performance bottlenecks

title: Resume Generator
description: A serverless resume generator utilizing the Anthropic messages API to create a structured markdown/html output that is rendered into a polished PDF resume, tailored to the input job description.
impact: A real gated workflow with challenge verification, session authorization, async generation, polling, and PDF delivery.
proof: Built a Turnstile-backed session flow for protected generation endpoints
Modeled async job submission, status polling, and expiring PDF download URLs
Kept a mock mode so the UI remains testable without deployed secrets

title: Site Design and RAG Chatbot Integration
description: A review of the site creation process and the design and integration of a RAG-powered Generative AI Chatbot
impact: A persistent assistant that follows users across Astro and Observable pages while staying grounded in the site's project corpus.
proof: Persisted conversation identity across mixed static and exported pages
Routed chat through session-gated API calls with graceful mock behavior
Documented the site-generation and assistant-integration architecture

title: Data Playground
description: Interactive data exploration and visualization sandbox.
impact: Draft space for compact experiments, visual checks, and reusable analysis components.
